betta-splendens.name: Ikan laga
notes: Item 1: 'hybrid of sorts' rendered as 'boleh dikatakan sejenis hibrid' is awkward; also 'Tiada' for N/A is fine but 'Copper Alien Hybrid ... daripada kompleks' is clumsy.
Item 5: 'patut tidak digalakkan' is unnatural; use 'patut dihalang' or 'tidak wajar digalakkan'.
Item 9: 'Saiz tangki minimum: kira-kira 8 liter' fine, but 'ikan laga' is used for 'bettas' while 'balang' for 'bowl' is OK; 'mungkin hujah terbesar menentang' is stiff.
Item 11: 'Betta fish are low-maintenance' translated as 'mudah dijaga' - fine, but 'tukar air' used as noun is clumsy; use 'penukaran air'.
Item 12: 'daun kering' for 'dried leaf litter' loses 'leaf litter' sense; 'pelompat yang handal' is awkward for 'excellent jumper' (use 'pelompat yang hebat').
Item 14: 'air panas' for warm water suggests hot water; use 'air suam/hangat'. Same in items 2, 7, 16 ('air panas' for warm water). 'dilaburkan' in item 16 is odd for buying a heater.
Item 16: the English 'Consider ... floating or digital thermometer' fine, but 5 watts per gallon converted to 1.3 W/L is correct.
Item 18: 'Brine shrimp' rendered 'Artemia' and 'Glassworm' left in English; add Malay/hobby equivalents e.g. 'cacing kaca'. 'flake' left in English in several items; 'serpihan' is common alternative.
Item 27: 'Tukar air perlu dibuat dalam kuantiti kecil' awkward; 'sehingga telur betina habis' ok. 'milt' left untranslated - use 'sperma/air mani ikan'.

Item 29: 'turquoise' rendered 'biru firus' fine; 'oren' fine. Item 21/22: 'Species with body shapes ... ' in 22 omits 'similar' mismatch: English says 'body shapes or trailing finnage' (to avoid), MS adds 'serupa' – an added qualifier that is not in the source.

paracheirodon-axelrodi.name: Cardinal tetra
notes: Item 5: "sejauh barat Colombia di sebelah barat" is redundant and garbled; use "hingga ke barat Colombia".
Item 20: English gives 26.5–29 °C (80–84 °F), but the Malay says "27–29 °C". The lower limit is wrong; 80 °F is about 26.5–27 °C, so write "26.5–29 °C".
Item 22: "Hypessobrycon simulans" and "P. inessi" repeat the source spellings. Latin names stay unchanged, so this is acceptable, but note the typo "Hypessobrycon".
Item 11: pH range "3.5–7.5" is kept as in the source, so no change is needed. The (GH) label was added to "Kekerasan air", which is fine.
Item 7: "hidup berkawan" is awkward for "live in shoals"; use "hidup berkawan/berkumpulan". The sentence also repeats "kawanan" from the previous one.
Item 21: "Ikan ini bertelur pada waktu petang" is fine. "wajib" for "essential" is slightly strong; "penting" is better.
Item 6: "menjulur ke atas air" for "overhanging" is acceptable. "hampir sebagai ikan tahunan" is awkward; use "hampir sepenuhnya ikan semusim".
Item 3: "jalur merahnya... memanjang di sepanjang badan" is slightly redundant, and "mid-body to tail" is rendered correctly.
Item 15: "flake" is left in English. Use "makanan serpihan (flake)".
Item 16: "ikan berkawan lain untuk memberi rasa selamat" is fine. "gasteropelecid" and similar family names are retained as in the source, which is acceptable.

paracheirodon-innesi.name: Neon Tetra
notes: Item 3: "Neon tetra pada umumnya semuanya hasil ternakan" is redundant and awkward. Use "Neon tetra yang dijual pada umumnya hasil ternakan".

poecilia-reticulata.name: Guppy
notes: #4: "saliran air panas" for "warm waterways" implies hot water or hot springs. Use "saliran air suam/hangat".
#15: "mudah dibawa berbincang" for "easygoing" is an odd idiom. Use "mudah dijaga" or "berwatak tenang".
#10: "tangki bertumbuhan dengan tumbuhan terapung" is awkward. Use "tangki bertumbuhan dengan tumbuhan terapung" or "tangki yang ditanam dengan tumbuhan akuatik termasuk tumbuhan terapung".
#20: "agresif" for "vigorous" shifts the meaning towards aggression. Use "bertenaga/gigih" for the males' pursuit.
#13: "flake" is left in English. Use "serpihan" or "makanan kepingan (flake)".

trigonostigma-heteromorpha.name: Harlequin rasbora
notes: Item 1: EN says 'Harlequin barb' but MS renders 'Harlequin rasbora' – the name was changed; keep faithful to the source or flag the discrepancy.

Item 8: '10 gallons (about 38 litres)' is correct, but 'Sehingga 10 ekor ... dalam akuarium 75 liter' is fine; the 'Saiz tangki minimum' line is OK. Note the 38 L minimum conflicts with item 9 (54 L), which comes from the source and not the translation.
Item 21: 'harlequin barb' was rendered as just 'harlequin'; this is acceptable but inconsistent with the source name.
Item 24: omitted the wholesale paragraph (codes 452523/452563 for Aquarium Glaser) and the byline; the byline and shop-talk omission is allowed, so no fix is needed there.

Item 22: 'Harlequin rasbora ... melekatkan telurnya' – 'egg layers' is rendered correctly, but 'Rasbora lain menabur telur secara rawak' adds 'secara rawak', which is not in the source sentence (minor).
Item 3: 'ikan ternakan kurang warnanya berbanding ikan liar' loses 'much of the colour' ('kehilangan banyak warna'); 'Harlequin' alone should be 'Harlequin rasbora'.
Item 22: 'jentik-jentik' for mosquito larvae is fine, but 'Harlequin lebih sukar dibiakkan' keeps 'Harlequins are among the more difficult', so this is OK.
Item 18: 'ikan keli' for 'catfishes' is misleading in Malaysia (keli means Clarias); use 'ikan duri/catfish' or 'ikan keli kecil (catfish)'.
Item 23: 'kekerasan 1–5 °H' is awkward; use dGH. 'mengurat' for male courtship is colloquial; use 'mengurat' or 'pamer pasangan' more neutrally.
Item 6: 'Rasbora ialah famili ikan air tawar sejati' – rasboras are not a family in the source's sense, but it follows the source, so no fix is needed.
